investigation_notes: Network security investigation of a monitored LAN. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over Zeek and Suricata logs (IDS alerts, Kerberos, HTTP downloads, TLS certificates, domains and external-destination activity). No root cause, impact or C2 attribution is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Network context: LAN segment range: 10.11.26.0/24 (10.11.26.0 through 10.11.26.255); Domain: nemotodes.health; Active Directory (AD) domain controller: 10.11.26.3 - NEMOTODES-DC; AD environment name: NEMOTODES; LAN segment gateway: 10.11.26.1; LAN segment broadcast address: 10.11.26.255.
